concepts.title: Hard-coded credential (API key, access token, service token)
concepts.description: A live-format credential that authenticates to a service (cloud key, VCS token, chat token, SaaS API key, bearer token, cookie/session credential) written as a literal in source, configuration, scripts or manifests.

concepts.title: Hard-coded password
concepts.description: A password literal in source or configuration, including passwords embedded in connection strings and in user:password@host URIs.

concepts.title: Hard-coded cryptographic key
concepts.description: A symmetric encryption key, IV, HMAC/JWT signing secret or key passphrase written as a literal and used by the program.

concepts.title: Committed private key material
concepts.description: An asymmetric private key (PEM block, keystore, PKCS#12/PFX, SSH key) committed to the repository.

concepts.title: Secret retained in version-control history
concepts.description: A credential that no longer exists in the working tree but remains readable in an earlier commit of the repository's history.

concepts.title: SQL injection
concepts.description: Untrusted input concatenated or interpolated into a SQL statement instead of being bound as a parameter.

concepts.title: OS command injection
concepts.description: Untrusted input reaching a shell or process-start command line.

concepts.title: Code / template injection
concepts.description: Untrusted input evaluated as code or as a server-side template.

concepts.title: Path traversal (incl. archive extraction 'zip slip')
concepts.description: A file path built from untrusted input (or an archive entry name) without canonicalisation and containment check.

concepts.title: XML external entity processing
concepts.description: An XML parser configured (or defaulting) to resolve external entities / DTDs on untrusted input.

concepts.title: Deserialization of untrusted data
concepts.description: Use of a type-embedding serializer (BinaryFormatter, NetDataContractSerializer, LosFormatter, unsafe JSON type handling …) on untrusted input.

concepts.title: Cross-site scripting / unescaped markup output
concepts.description: Untrusted or document-derived text written into HTML/markup without encoding.

concepts.title: Regular expression denial of service
concepts.description: A backtracking regular expression applied to untrusted input with catastrophic patterns or without a match timeout.

concepts.title: LDAP injection
concepts.description: Untrusted input concatenated into an LDAP filter.

concepts.title: XPath injection
concepts.description: Untrusted input concatenated into an XPath expression.

concepts.title: Server-side request forgery / bypassable address filter
concepts.description: An outbound request to a caller-chosen address, or an address allow/deny check that embedded-IPv4 encodings (IPv4-mapped/compatible IPv6, 6to4, NAT64) can bypass.

concepts.title: Open redirect
concepts.description: A redirect to a URL taken from the request without validation.

concepts.title: Broken or risky cryptographic algorithm or mode
concepts.description: Use of DES/3DES/RC4, ECB mode, weak RSA padding or comparable deprecated primitives.

concepts.title: Weak hash used for a security purpose
concepts.description: MD5/SHA-1 used where collision or preimage resistance matters (passwords, signatures, integrity).

concepts.title: Insecure randomness for security values
concepts.description: A non-cryptographic PRNG generating keys, tokens, salts or identifiers that must be unguessable.

concepts.title: Missing authorization on an endpoint
concepts.description: A state-changing or data-returning endpoint reachable without an authorization check.

concepts.title: Mass assignment
concepts.description: Binding request data directly onto a persistence/domain object so callers can set fields they must not control.

concepts.title: Stack trace / error detail exposed to clients
concepts.description: Exception details or stack traces returned in responses.

concepts.title: Improper certificate validation
concepts.description: TLS/X.509 validation disabled or replaced by a check that accepts invalid certificates.

concepts.title: Security token signature or lifetime not validated
concepts.description: JWT/security-token validation that skips signature verification or expiry/lifetime validation.

concepts.title: Sensitive or personal data written to logs
concepts.description: Personal data, credentials or tokens reaching a log or console sink.

concepts.title: Sensitive data in URL / query string
concepts.description: Personal data or secrets placed in a URL, path or query string.

concepts.title: Sensitive data in unprotected browser storage
concepts.description: Personal data or tokens persisted in localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB or non-HttpOnly cookies.

concepts.title: Allocation or read sized by an unvalidated length field
concepts.description: An integer length read from an untrusted stream/reader used for an allocation or bulk read without an upper bound.

concepts.title: Uncontrolled recursion over caller-supplied input
concepts.description: A recursive walk over a caller-supplied document (JSON/XML tree) with no depth limit.

concepts.title: CI workflow expression / script injection
concepts.description: Attacker-controlled CI context (PR title, branch name, comment body) interpolated into a pipeline shell step.

concepts.title: CI secret exposed to untrusted code
concepts.description: Pipeline secrets made available to untrusted code: privileged triggers that build fork code, secrets passed to third-party steps or promoted to job-wide environment.

concepts.title: Third-party CI action not pinned to an immutable reference
concepts.description: A CI step referencing a third-party action/orb/image by mutable tag or branch instead of a full commit digest.

concepts.title: Remote code downloaded and executed without integrity check
concepts.description: curl|sh, Invoke-WebRequest|iex or an unverified installer download in build scripts, Dockerfiles or CI.

concepts.title: Container runs with excessive privilege
concepts.description: Container/workload running as root, privileged, with added capabilities, host namespaces or a writable root filesystem.

concepts.title: Workload without resource limits
concepts.description: A container/pod specification without CPU/memory limits.

concepts.title: Container image referenced by mutable tag
concepts.description: A base or runtime image referenced by ':latest' or another mutable tag instead of a pinned version/digest.

concepts.title: Other infrastructure-as-code / container misconfiguration
concepts.description: A misconfiguration in Dockerfile, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform or CloudFormation not covered by a more specific concept (missing healthcheck, exposed admin port, public bucket …).

concepts.title: Dependency with a known vulnerability
concepts.description: A declared or locked third-party package version affected by a published advisory (CVE/GHSA/OSV).

concepts.title: Known-malicious dependency
concepts.description: A dependency whose version is classified as malicious by a malicious-package feed.

concepts.title: End-of-life runtime or framework
concepts.description: A pinned runtime (target framework, Node/Python version) or framework major past its vendor end-of-support date.

concepts.title: Outdated dependency
concepts.description: A dependency several releases behind its latest version (staleness, not a known vulnerability).

concepts.title: Deprecated dependency
concepts.description: A dependency its publisher has marked deprecated.

concepts.title: Dependency license incompatible with policy
concepts.description: A third-party package whose declared license is denied or copyleft-incompatible under the configured policy.

concepts.title: Dependencies not locked
concepts.description: An ecosystem in the repository resolves dependencies without a lockfile or central version pinning, so builds are not reproducible.

concepts.title: Declared dependency never used
concepts.description: A package declared in a manifest that no source file imports.

concepts.title: Imported package not declared
concepts.description: A package imported by source but declared in no manifest (works only transitively or by accident).

concepts.title: Development-only package declared as a production dependency
concepts.description: Type, test or build-only packages declared as runtime dependencies.

concepts.title: Build provenance, signing and SBOM
concepts.description: Release pipeline generates provenance/attestations, signs artifacts and publishes an SBOM.

concepts.title: Vulnerability disclosure policy present
concepts.description: A SECURITY.md or security.txt with a reporting contact exists.

concepts.title: Vulnerability disclosure policy is a real process
concepts.description: The disclosure policy states contact, reporting and handling expectations rather than being a stub.

concepts.title: Security response headers configured
concepts.description: CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, frame policy, Referrer-Policy configured by the application.

concepts.title: HTTPS enforced by the application
concepts.description: HTTPS redirection / HSTS or an explicit TLS-terminating proxy configuration.

concepts.title: Cookie without Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite
concepts.description: An authentication or session cookie issued without the Secure flag (and/or HttpOnly / SameSite).

concepts.title: Inbound request model validation
concepts.description: Request models are validated (annotations, validators, schema) before use.

concepts.title: Security tooling gates changes
concepts.description: SAST, dependency-update automation and secret scanning run in CI on pull requests.

concepts.title: Network egress restricted for workloads
concepts.description: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy/Cilium policy restricting workload egress.

concepts.title: Workload syscall / MAC confinement
concepts.description: seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault/Localhost) and AppArmor/SELinux on workloads.

concepts.title: Runtime threat detection and admission control
concepts.description: Falco/Tetragon runtime detection and Kyverno/Gatekeeper/PodSecurity admission policies.

concepts.title: Data protection / encryption controls
concepts.description: Sensitive data is encrypted at rest/in transit (column encryption, key vault, data-protection APIs, KDFs).

concepts.title: Authorization enforcement posture
concepts.description: Endpoints are protected by authorization attributes/policies or explicit guard checks.

concepts.title: Audit trail of changes
concepts.description: Changes to business data are recorded in an immutable/interceptor-based audit trail.

concepts.title: Data retention / TTL controls
concepts.description: Personal data has a retention policy or TTL enforced in schema or jobs.

concepts.title: Data-subject rights (erasure / export / consent)
concepts.description: The system implements erasure, export and consent operations for personal data.

concepts.title: Personal-data fields handled
concepts.description: Which source types carry genuine personal data (as opposed to fictional/test/config values).

concepts.title: Dev / test / prod configuration separation
concepts.description: Environment configuration keeps development, test and production settings and secrets separate.

concepts.title: Personal data in an append-only event store
concepts.description: Persisted events carry personal data that an immutable store cannot erase.

concepts.title: Function with high cyclomatic complexity
concepts.description: A method/function whose decision-point count exceeds the threshold.

concepts.title: Function with high cognitive complexity
concepts.description: A method/function hard to follow because of nesting and flow breaks (Sonar-style cognitive complexity).

concepts.title: Oversized class (god class)
concepts.description: A class with too many lines or members that concentrates unrelated responsibilities.

concepts.title: Oversized source file / component
concepts.description: A source file or UI component exceeding the size threshold.

concepts.title: Duplicated code
concepts.description: Copy-pasted code blocks or identical long conditions that should be shared.

concepts.title: Low class cohesion (LCOM)
concepts.description: A class whose methods split into disconnected groups sharing no state or calls.

concepts.title: TODO / FIXME / HACK marker
concepts.description: A comment marking known unfinished or questionable work.

concepts.title: Suppressed compiler / analyzer diagnostic
concepts.description: A pragma or attribute disabling a warning or analyzer rule.

concepts.title: Commented-out code
concepts.description: Blocks of code left in comments.

concepts.title: Unused code (dead symbols, unreachable files, unused exports)
concepts.description: Types, members, files or exports that nothing references.

concepts.title: Unreachable branch or region
concepts.description: A branch, case label or conditional-compilation region that can never execute.

concepts.title: Not-implemented stub or placeholder in shipped code
concepts.description: NotImplementedException throws or placeholder literals in production code.

concepts.title: Incomplete implementation by code shape
concepts.description: Constant-returning stubs, async methods that never await, guards that cannot change the outcome, comparisons against NaN, skeleton types.

concepts.title: Empty catch block (swallowed exception)
concepts.description: A catch clause that discards the exception without handling or logging it.

concepts.title: Catch that only rethrows
concepts.description: A catch clause whose only statement rethrows, adding nothing.

concepts.title: Blocking on asynchronous code (sync-over-async)
concepts.description: .Wait()/.Result/.GetAwaiter().GetResult() or a blocking call inside an async function.

concepts.title: async void outside event handlers
concepts.description: An async void method whose exceptions cannot be observed.

concepts.title: Async operation without cancellation
concepts.description: An async method/function performing I/O that accepts and forwards no cancellation token/signal.

concepts.title: Log message built by string interpolation
concepts.description: A logging call whose message template is an interpolated/concatenated string instead of a structured template with arguments.

concepts.title: Null-safety analysis not enabled
concepts.description: Projects compile without nullable reference types / strict null checks.

concepts.title: Null-safety suppressed with the null-forgiving operator
concepts.description: The '!' operator (or equivalent non-null assertion) silencing null-safety analysis.

concepts.title: Hand-rolled JSON/XML parsing
concepts.description: Regex or string slicing used to extract values from JSON/XML when a parser is available.

concepts.title: Failure path silently falls back to a constant
concepts.description: A parse/lookup failure returns a hard-coded default with no logging or signal to the caller.

concepts.title: JavaScript interop call to a missing function
concepts.description: A string-named JS interop invocation that no referenced script defines.

concepts.title: Subsumed operand in a boolean condition
concepts.description: An operand of an &&/|| chain implied by another operand, so it can never change the result.

concepts.title: Child process output stream never drained
concepts.description: A child process started with redirected stdout and stderr where one stream is never read, risking a pipe-buffer deadlock.

concepts.title: Truncation loop without a lower bound
concepts.description: A loop that removes the last character of a string until a condition holds, with nothing stopping it at the empty string.

concepts.title: Disposable resource ownership defect
concepts.description: A type that disposes a value it was handed, never releases one it created, or holds a pointless finalizer.

concepts.title: Process-global state not restored on failure
concepts.description: Working directory or environment variable changed and restored only on the success path, not in finally.

concepts.title: Null guard that tests a non-null condition
concepts.description: An ArgumentNullException-style guard whose condition is true for a non-null argument (emptiness), or that dereferences it.

concepts.title: Mutation inside a short-circuited guard
concepts.description: A pattern/switch guard that mutates state in a position its own short-circuit can skip.

concepts.title: Lock release guarded by inconsistent state
concepts.description: A finally that releases a synchronisation primitive based on a flag the method's own returns contradict.

concepts.title: Expensive argument evaluated for a disabled log level
concepts.description: A debug/trace log call whose argument materialises a sequence or serializes data without a level check.

concepts.title: Configuration option that has no effect
concepts.description: A constructor-injected option with a fallback that nothing reads, or whose fallback is duplicated elsewhere.

concepts.title: Non-thread-safe collection handed across callbacks
concepts.description: A non-thread-safe collection shared between a callback and the waiting code without synchronisation.

concepts.title: Collection modified while being enumerated
concepts.description: A foreach body that adds/removes on the collection it iterates.

concepts.title: Index access outside its own emptiness guard
concepts.description: A condition that tests a collection/string for emptiness but indexes it on a branch that the test does not protect.

concepts.title: Per-element decision taken from a fixed element
concepts.description: Inside a loop over elements, a condition that never mentions the loop variable guards an action indexed by it.

concepts.title: Support check that admits what it should reject
concepts.description: A negated disjunction whose operands disagree in polarity, so the guard accepts inputs it was written to reject.

concepts.title: Test-only API exported from production code
concepts.description: Functions exported from a production module only for tests.

concepts.title: Type resolved by simple name across all loaded assemblies
concepts.description: A First/Single over every type of every loaded assembly matched by name, which is ambiguous and slow.

concepts.title: Library awaits without ConfigureAwait(false)
concepts.description: Library code that captures the synchronisation context on await.

concepts.title: Allocation-aware API usage
concepts.description: Density of allocation-conscious APIs (spans, pools, value tasks, preallocation) in production code.

concepts.title: Oversized compiled method bodies
concepts.description: Share of methods whose emitted IL/bytecode exceeds the size threshold.

concepts.title: Untyped JavaScript share of the frontend
concepts.description: Share of frontend source written in plain JavaScript rather than TypeScript.

concepts.title: Inconsistent naming
concepts.description: Identifiers that do not follow a consistent, descriptive naming convention.

concepts.title: Low-value or misleading comments
concepts.description: Comments that restate code, are stale, or mislead.

concepts.title: Circular dependency between modules/projects
concepts.description: Projects, packages or modules that depend on each other in a cycle.

concepts.title: Stable modules depending on volatile ones
concepts.description: A module many others depend on that itself has high instability (efferent coupling).

concepts.title: Architecture decisions not enforced
concepts.description: Checkable architecture decisions without an automated enforcement (architecture tests, analyzers).

concepts.title: Layer / boundary dependency violation
concepts.description: A dependency pointing the wrong way between layers (domain -> infrastructure, app -> web) or a deep import across a package boundary.

concepts.title: Domain type leaking across a bounded-context boundary
concepts.description: Public surface of one context exposing another context's domain types instead of ids/contracts.

concepts.title: Oversized project / module
concepts.description: A project exceeding size thresholds in lines, public types and namespaces.

concepts.title: Excessive call indirection
concepts.description: Calls that hop through many interfaces/namespaces relative to the codebase size.

concepts.title: Change coupling between files
concepts.description: Files that repeatedly change together in history without a structural dependency.

concepts.title: Captive dependency (lifetime mismatch)
concepts.description: A long-lived (singleton) service capturing a shorter-lived (scoped/transient) dependency.

concepts.title: Unsynchronised mutable state in a shared singleton
concepts.description: A singleton service mutating fields without locking or atomic operations.

concepts.title: Architecture style fits the codebase
concepts.description: Detected architecture style (layered, clean, vertical slice, CQRS) and its fitness for the codebase size.

concepts.title: Fat interface (interface segregation)
concepts.description: An interface declaring too many members for its consumers.

concepts.title: Coupling between feature slices
concepts.description: A vertical feature slice referencing another slice's types.

concepts.title: Production project references test code
concepts.description: A production project/module referencing a test project or test framework.

concepts.title: Query handler with side effects (CQS violation)
concepts.description: A query handler that writes state or publishes events.

concepts.title: Business-logic share of production code
concepts.description: Share of production lines in domain/application roles versus infrastructure and glue.

concepts.title: Solution / workspace structure
concepts.description: Project decomposition, shell projects and whether the solution builds.

concepts.title: Inconsistent internal API conventions
concepts.description: Public API surface that mixes conventions (naming, async, error handling, return shapes).

concepts.title: Folder and project structure conventions
concepts.description: src/test separation and consistent root namespaces.

concepts.title: Aggregate holds an object reference to another aggregate
concepts.description: An aggregate field typed as another aggregate root instead of its id.

concepts.title: Entity identified by a raw primitive
concepts.description: Entity/event ids typed as Guid/int/string instead of strongly-typed id value types.

concepts.title: Integration event exposes producer domain types
concepts.description: An integration event property typed with the producer's internal domain type or enum.

concepts.title: Anemic domain model
concepts.description: Domain entities with state but no behaviour that protects their invariants.

concepts.title: Entity state publicly mutable
concepts.description: Public setters or exposed mutable collections on domain entities.

concepts.title: Domain layer depends on infrastructure
concepts.description: Domain types calling or exposing persistence, HTTP, messaging or cache types.

concepts.title: Repository over a non-aggregate or leaking query handles
concepts.description: A repository for a non-root entity, or a repository interface returning IQueryable/DbSet-style live query handles.

concepts.title: Primitive obsession (missing value object)
concepts.description: Recurring clusters of primitive parameters that should be a value object.

concepts.title: Domain rule decided outside its owning type
concepts.description: The same predicate over a domain type's members evaluated in several other types.

concepts.title: One operation mutates several aggregates
concepts.description: A single method writing more than one aggregate type through repositories.

concepts.title: Entity constructible in an invalid state
concepts.description: A public constructor taking raw primitives with no guard and no validating factory.

concepts.title: Ambient clock/random read inside the domain
concepts.description: Domain code reading DateTime.Now, random generators or timers directly instead of receiving them.

concepts.title: Synchronous remote call inside an event handler
concepts.description: An event handler that performs HTTP/gRPC calls, coupling it temporally to another service.

concepts.title: Command handled by more or fewer than one handler
concepts.description: A command message with zero or several handlers.

concepts.title: Event not named in the past tense
concepts.description: Domain/integration event names that do not describe something that happened.

concepts.title: Database write and message publish without an outbox
concepts.description: A handler that saves state and publishes a message with no transactional outbox.

concepts.title: Non-idempotent message handler
concepts.description: A command/event consumer that mutates state without an idempotency guard.

concepts.title: Non-deterministic event application
concepts.description: An event-sourcing Apply/When fold that reads the clock, random values, GUID generation or I/O.

concepts.title: Persisted event is mutable
concepts.description: Events in the event store with public setters or mutable fields.

concepts.title: Test coverage
concepts.description: Share of production code exercised by tests (measured line coverage, or static reachability from tests).

concepts.title: Test distribution across levels
concepts.description: Balance of unit, integration, BDD and end-to-end tests.

concepts.title: Test without an assertion
concepts.description: A test method that asserts nothing.

concepts.title: Skipped test without a structured reason
concepts.description: A skipped/ignored test without a documented, categorised reason.

concepts.title: Test dominated by mocks
concepts.description: A test whose setup is mostly mocks, testing wiring rather than behaviour.

concepts.title: Flaky (non-deterministic) test
concepts.description: A test that passes and fails across identical runs.

concepts.title: Domain versus controller test coverage
concepts.description: Ratio of test coverage on domain logic versus thin web/controller code.

concepts.title: Executable specifications (BDD)
concepts.description: Gherkin/BDD specifications wired to a runner.

concepts.title: CI test gate honesty
concepts.description: CI test gates that run the whole suite before merge, gate coverage, and do not exclude suites by filter.

concepts.title: CI pipeline builds and tests
concepts.description: A CI workflow exists and runs build and test stages.

concepts.title: Observability (structured logging, tracing, health checks)
concepts.description: Structured logging across runnable modules, telemetry and health endpoints.

concepts.title: Deployment and rollback safety
concepts.description: Deploy manifests with rolling updates, probes, approval gates and migration hooks.

concepts.title: Disaster recovery and backup evidence
concepts.description: Backup, restore, RTO/RPO and persistence guarantees evidenced in IaC, manifests or docs.

concepts.title: Release hygiene (changelog, versioning)
concepts.description: A maintained changelog and version tags/properties.

concepts.title: Outbound HTTP calls bounded by timeout/retry/breaker
concepts.description: Outbound HTTP clients configured with timeouts, retries or circuit breakers.

concepts.title: Versioned schema migrations
concepts.description: Database schema evolved by versioned migrations, not auto-created at runtime.

concepts.title: Library public API and semantic versioning
concepts.description: A published library controls its public surface and declares semantic versions.

concepts.title: Test/lint/typecheck scripts wired
concepts.description: package.json wires test, lint and typecheck scripts.

concepts.title: Performance benchmarks
concepts.description: Benchmarks exist (BenchmarkDotNet, tinybench …), track allocations and run in CI.

concepts.title: README present and substantive
concepts.description: A root README with getting-started, testing and architecture sections of reasonable depth.

concepts.title: Architecture documentation and ADRs
concepts.description: Architecture decision records and an architecture overview/diagram.

concepts.title: Documentation quality
concepts.description: Clarity, completeness and usefulness of READMEs and architecture docs.

concepts.title: ADR quality
concepts.description: Decision records with context, decision, consequences and enforcement.

concepts.title: Code conforms to recorded decisions
concepts.description: The codebase follows what its ADRs decided.

concepts.title: Documentation matches the code
concepts.description: README/docs describe the projects and commands that actually exist.

concepts.title: Churn x complexity hotspot
concepts.description: Files that are both complex and frequently changed.

concepts.title: Knowledge concentration (bus factor)
concepts.description: Living knowledge of key files concentrated in very few authors.

concepts.title: Orphaned knowledge (stale files)
concepts.description: Files whose authors' knowledge has decayed below one focused commit's worth.

concepts.title: Missing text alternative
concepts.description: Images, image inputs, SVG images and video without alt text, title or captions (WCAG 1.1.1, 1.2.2).

concepts.title: Form control without accessible label
concepts.description: Inputs, selects, textareas and buttons without an associated label or accessible name (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).

concepts.title: Page structure / landmark violation
concepts.description: Missing lang/title/main landmark, skipped heading levels, zoom-disabling viewport, untitled iframe, meta refresh.

concepts.title: Interaction not keyboard accessible
concepts.description: Click handlers on non-interactive elements without role/tabindex/key handler, positive tabindex, href-less anchors (WCAG 2.1.1).

concepts.title: Invalid ARIA usage
concepts.description: Invalid/abstract roles, missing required ARIA state, aria-hidden on focusable elements (WCAG 4.1.2).

concepts.title: Contrast, focus visibility and motion safety
concepts.description: Insufficient text contrast, removed focus outline, animation without prefers-reduced-motion guard.

concepts.title: Accessibility checks enforced
concepts.description: An accessibility lint rule set and automated accessibility assertions in tests/CI.

concepts.title: Alt text is meaningful
concepts.description: Static alt text conveys the image's purpose rather than a filename or generic word.

concepts.title: Link and button text is descriptive
concepts.description: Link/button text conveys its purpose out of context (not 'click here').

concepts.title: Heading and label text is descriptive
concepts.description: Headings and labels describe their section/field rather than placeholders.

concepts.title: Authenticated surface reachable without credentials
concepts.description: A page/API reachable with a session that also answers without any credentials.

concepts.title: Application declares a reproducible boot
concepts.description: docker-compose / Aspire AppHost / Dockerfile allowing the app to be booted for runtime evidence.

concepts.title: Served API differs from the committed API description
concepts.description: Operations served by the running app that its committed OpenAPI document does not declare (or vice versa).

concepts.title: Third-party data flows from the UI
concepts.description: Third-party hosts (analytics, trackers) the rendered UI contacts.

concepts.title: Network port exposed beyond declaration
concepts.description: A published network binding not declared in the repository's own ports/expose configuration.
